I am 65 this year. I have farmed my 10.7 mu in Quzhou for 30 years. I only finished primary school, and everything I know comes from my father and from watching the good farmers in my village. I plant wheat in October and maize in June on the same land, wheat-maize rotation, year after year.

For my wheat, I buy improved seed, the kind most people here use — Jimai or Lunxuan, about 30 jin per mu. Before sowing I run the rotary tiller over the field. For fertilizer, I put one 50kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base, the bag from the dealer that says 20-20-5. Then in spring when the wheat turns green, I spread 40kg of urea per mu. At jointing time I add another half bag of compound, about 25kg per mu. The dealer told me this is about 34kg of nitrogen, 20kg of phosphorus, and 8kg of potassium per mu. I know it is a lot, but last year I used almost the same and I got about 1000 jin per mu. I will not risk cutting back — a bad harvest is a disaster, wasting some fertilizer is just a cost. I irrigate three times from my well: winter irrigation before the frost, once at jointing, and once at grain filling. For chemicals I spray herbicide once in early spring, insecticide once when the aphids come, and fungicide once at heading, and sometimes a growth regulator — four times total. If the weather is normal I expect 500kg per mu, same as last year.

For my maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in June. No time to till, so I plant directly into the wheat stubble, no-tillage. I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan 958 or whatever the dealer has that my neighbors say is good, about one and a half packages per mu. I put 50kg of compound fertilizer per mu at planting, the 20-10-10 kind. Then at the big trumpet stage I add 25kg of urea per mu. That is about 22kg nitrogen, 6kg phosphorus, and 6kg potassium per mu. I irrigate twice from my well if the rain does not come — once when the plants are knee-high and once when they tassel. For chemicals I spray herbicide right after sowing and insecticide twice for corn borer, three times total. I expect about 600kg per mu.

Money is always tight. All the fertilizer, seed, chemicals, and diesel for the pump cost me seven or eight thousand yuan for the year. But what can I do? If I use less fertilizer and the yield drops by even 100 jin per mu, I lose thousands of yuan. I would rather put a little too much than too little. This is what I did last year and it worked, so this year I will do the same. I watch my neighbors, and they do about the same. If everyone around you applies this much, you probably do something similar.
